title: Sixi Arena evidence report (evidence.json)
description: (2.2.0, K8) The machine-readable evidence document (EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE.md Part 1 and Appendix A), aligned with the scanner's `sixi.scanner.evidence/v1` importer rules: all or nothing, gaps only, clause ids from the corpus. Built outside the engine from sealed Reports, the pack manifests, the corpus snapshot and the cross-check record; listed in `bundle-manifest.json`, so the bundle signature covers it. Wording rule (template R1): the report assesses, evidences and reproduces; no enum, example, description or rendered string of this document uses the forbidden conformity words (checked by contract-check). Ids and counts only (R3): no target text, press text, prompts, payloads, URL query values or credentials; labels are untrusted data. A run set with no completed episode yields `assessed: false` and no records (R2).

region.description: The processing region (default europe-west6). (2.9.0) An explicit list of Google Cloud regions, not a pattern: the regions in EU member states plus europe-west6 (Zürich, Switzerland), the same list the Sixi control plane enforces at startup. `europe-west2` (London, not in the EU) and every region outside the EU and Switzerland are refused. No fallback region exists (HOSTED-PROFILE §4.1). A region is added to this list on purpose, as a contract MINOR, in every copy at once (hosted_context, report run.hosted, evidence_report producer and scope, deletion_receipt; signing.md §3.2 rule M9).

status_line.const: Reproducible, run by Sixi against a verified origin.
status_line.description: The one allowed status statement for a hosted evidence report (threat-model-arena.md §3.4).

assessed.description: false iff no episode of any run in scope completed (the target was never usefully reached).

org_ref.description: Opaque organisation reference. Never a name.

scan_id.description: The scan this run belongs to (one scan = |scenarios| x |tiers| runs).

verified_origin.description: The verified origin the run was allowed to reach. The runner refuses to start if it differs from the RunSpec target's origin.

origin.description: An origin: scheme, lower-case host and optional port. No path, query, fragment or userinfo.

method.description: How control of the host was proven (HOSTED-PROFILE §1.2.1).

checked_at.description: When the control plane re-checked the proof at admission (a result cached for at most 24 hours is accepted).

record_id.description: Opaque id of the ownership verification record.

target_path_redacted.description: The target path, shown without query or fragment.

credential_mode.description: How the target is authenticated (HOSTED-PROFILE §2.5). Only the mode is ever recorded, never a value.

region.description: The processing region (default europe-west6). (2.9.0) An explicit list of Google Cloud regions, not a pattern: the regions in EU member states plus europe-west6 (Zürich, Switzerland), the same list the Sixi control plane enforces at startup. `europe-west2` (London, not in the EU) and every region outside the EU and Switzerland are refused. actor_id.description: An id (for a token: the token id, never its value).

ci.description: Untrusted CI labels, displayed as data.

image_digest.description: The runner image, pinned by digest, never a tag (HOSTED-PROFILE §2.2). (2.6.0) The runner proves which image it is from the job-template variable ARENA_IMAGE_DIGEST = "<index>,<platform manifest>" (signing.md §3.1): both digests here MUST be listed in it and `platform` MUST be the running platform, else hosted_context_invalid (detail.field `/image_digest/index`, `/image_digest/platform_manifest`, `/image_digest/platform`, or `/image_digest` when the variable is absent or malformed).

index.description: The multi-arch image index digest (ghcr.io/rbrus/agent-arena@<index>), exactly as release.yml records and sandbox verify.sh prints as IMAGE_DIGEST.

platform_manifest.description: The platform manifest digest actually run.

packs.description: Scenario packs mounted for the run (none = open scenarios only). (2.6.0, signing.md §11) Each is mounted read-only at `$ARENA_PACKS_DIR/<id>/pack.dsse.json` (plus its variant data files); ARENA_PACKS_DIR is required when this list is not empty.

digest.description: (2.6.0, signing.md §11.2) "sha256:" + hex(sha256(the exact bytes of the pack's `pack.dsse.json` envelope)), as fetched from the pack store and mounted. The runner refuses a mounted envelope whose bytes digest differently (scenario_pack_unavailable).

crosscheck.description: The cross-check record for the image digest that ran (crosscheck_record.schema.json).

failed_after_seal.description: true when a cross-check on this digest failed after the run was sealed (`crosscheck_failed_after_seal`).

status.description: The open CLI's `verify` re-simulated every episode before signing and returned verified (exit 0).

unverified_fields.description: JSON Pointers accepted as recorded by the runner, not re-derived (e.g. /run/started_at).

items.description: One row per run (one scenario x tier), EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE §3.

recorded_seats.description: Seats other than the primary target whose moves are recorded inputs (ADR-004). An llm_peer seat is rendered as "recorded, not regenerated".

items.description: One row per catalog oracle per run, EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE §4.

state.description: broke = any episode's verdict was fail; held = every assessed episode passed and at least one was assessed (a statement about these seeds, this tier and this window only); not_assessed = no episode assessed the oracle. Never two states.

items.description: One finding = (pack rule, or oracle when no pack applies) x seat within one run (HOSTED-PROFILE §5.5). Built from ids and counts only.

rule_id.description: The pack rule that produced the finding; absent when no pack applies (the finding is then the oracle itself).

verdict_severity.description: The verdict severity = the SARIF level.

pack_severity.description: The pack rule's evidence-view severity; never changes a SARIF level.

reproduced.description: N: assessed episodes where the rule held.

trials.description: M: assessed episodes (pass or fail) for this oracle and seat; not_assessed episodes are never counted. 0 = reproduction not measured (run-level oracles).

distinct_trajectories.description: Distinct trajectory_class values among the M episodes; always shown next to N of M.

items.description: A clause id in the `sixi-assure-rules` corpus format REGIME:DOC:REF, e.g. `OWASP:AgenticTop10:ASI01`, `OWASP:LLMTop10:LLM01`, `AIACT:2024/1689:Art15(4)`. Only the regimes this contract release knows (OWASP, AIACT) match; `OWASP-AGENTIC:…` and `ATLAS:…` are not regime ids and are rejected. Adding a regime is a contract MINOR. The pack load additionally resolves every id against the corpus snapshot `corpus.ref`; an id that does not resolve fails the load (it is never shown as "no clause found").

clauses.description: Corpus clause ids the finding bears on (from the pack rule or clause map); empty when no pack applies.

items.description: A MITRE ATLAS technique id, used as a lens label only (never a clause citation, never the source of a finding).

evidence_ids.description: Evidence ids (messages, orders, commitments, canaries); never their text.

inspector_link.description: Deep link into the Sixi-hosted build of the open replay inspector (hash parameters only).

items.description: A clause record (EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE §5.1). Written only when a finding bears on the clause.

clause_id.description: A clause id in the `sixi-assure-rules` corpus format REGIME:DOC:REF, e.g. `OWASP:AgenticTop10:ASI01`, `OWASP:LLMTop10:LLM01`, `AIACT:2024/1689:Art15(4)`. decision.description: The only decision an arena record can carry: at least one finding bears on the clause. There is no positive decision (gaps only).

statement.description: Templated from ids and counts only (e.g. "1 finding bears on this clause: SXA-BYZ-001 reproduced 3 of 5 (2 distinct trajectories).").

disclaimer.description: Key of the regime disclaimer in corpus/disclaimers.json.

assessed_no_finding_clauses.description: Clauses whose mapped oracles all held on these seeds. For the reviewer's information only: never evidence that a clause is met, never counted.

not_assessed.description: EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE §6 (mandatory, never omitted, never collapsed; empty lists stay present). Nothing here is ever counted as a pass.

sarif_kind.description: The SARIF kind of these verdicts (sarif-mapping.md §3, 2.5.0): notApplicable exactly for the not-applicable reason codes (precondition_not_reached, not_applicable_to_seat, not_applicable_to_tier, no_request_delivered, single_owner_table, shared_owner, no_canary_delivered), open otherwise. When an entry mixes reasons of both kinds, open.

unmapped_clauses.description: Clauses in the requested regimes that no arena oracle maps to: not assessed at all.

kind.description: What is not assessed: a scenario, an oracle (SARIF rule id), a clause (corpus id), a seat, or a named property of the evaluation.

id.description: scenario: a scenario id; oracle: an oracle id; clause: a corpus clause id (`OWASP:…`, `AIACT:…`); seat: a seat id; property: a dotted property id (e.g. `robustness.seed_recovery`, `target.model_identity`).

reason_code.description: Stable, append-only within contracts MAJOR 2. oracle_not_assessed = every verdict of the oracle (for `seat`) was not_assessed; oracle_partially_not_assessed = some were (verdict_reasons has the counts); no_episode_completed = every episode aborted; recorded_not_regenerated = a recorded peer seat: its moves are recorded inputs and its model was not re-run (ADR-004); commitments_unsigned = Diplomacy commitments were attributed by seat (sig_mode session), not by verified signatures; clause_not_mapped_in_run = a clause in a mounted pack's coverage that no oracle of this run maps to; clause_oracles_not_assessed = every oracle of this run mapped to the clause was not assessed; seed_recovery_not_modelled = scripted adversaries are functions of a 32-bit seed, so robustness against an agent that recovers the seed is not assessed (threat-model-hosted.md §2.5); pack_data_required = an `sx_` scenario re-simulates only with the pack's data; out_of_scope_by_design = never assessed by the arena (e.g. model identity, production equivalence).

basis.description: resim = derived from the RunSpec and the episodes; `verify` recomputes the entry and fails on a difference. recorded = supplied by the runner from the scenario catalog, a mounted pack or the hosted profile; bound by the signature on a hosted report, listed by `verify` as unverified.

episodes.description: Episodes the entry applies to (oracle and seat entries).

verdict_reasons.description: oracle entries: count of not_assessed verdicts per verdict reason_code.

pack.description: clause entries: the pack whose coverage lists the clause.

report_entries.description: Every Report `not_assessed` entry of every run in scope, copied verbatim (run order), so the signed per-run lists and this section cannot disagree.

standing_exclusions.description: EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE §6.5, in every report: model identity, production equivalence, behaviour beyond the scenario frames, harms no oracle defines, single-target collusion, content quality and obligations not cited. All six are required.

unresolved_clauses.description: (2.5.0, optional) Clause ids that a mounted pack names but the corpus snapshot supplied to the renderer (`build.corpus`) does not resolve, each with reason `clause_unresolved`, in id order. The pack LOAD still refuses an id that does not resolve against the snapshot pinned at admission, so a scan never starts with one. An entry here means the renderer's snapshot differs from the admission snapshot (for example, a clause was withdrawn in between). An unresolved id is listed only here: it appears in no finding, record, `assessed_no_finding_clauses` or coverage list, it carries no title or paraphrase, and the Markdown renders its citation as "no clause found". Absent or empty means every clause resolved. This relaxes EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE R4 ("a non-resolving id fails the build") to "a non-resolving id is never cited and is listed here".

clause_id.description: A clause id in the `sixi-assure-rules` corpus format REGIME:DOC:REF, e.g. `OWASP:AgenticTop10:ASI01`, `OWASP:LLMTop10:LLM01`, `AIACT:2024/1689:Art15(4)`. Only the regimes this contract release knows (OWASP, AIACT) match; `OWASP-AGENTIC:…` and `ATLAS:…` are not regime ids and are rejected. Adding a regime is a contract MINOR. The pack load additionally resolves every id against the corpus snapshot `corpus.ref`; an id that does not resolve fails the load (it is never shown as "no clause found").

pack.description: The mounted pack that names the clause.

limitations.description: EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE §8 as codes. The first seven apply to every hosted run and are required; the run-specific ones are added when they apply.

retention.description: EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE §10; the credential is never stored.

signature.description: EVIDENCE-REPORT-TEMPLATE §11. This document is covered by the bundle-manifest signature (R7).

records.statement: 1 finding bears on this clause: diplomacy_standard.injection_followed reproduced 1 of 1 (1 distinct trajectory).

disclosure.conflict_of_interest: This arena is maintained by Sixi AI, the vendor of a tool it may be used to score. Verdicts are computed by deterministic, published oracles over hash-committed replays; scoring is oracle-first and tool-blind.
disclosure.hosted_addendum: Sixi AI operated this run and sells the hosted evaluation. The referee ran no model.
disclosure.llm_peers_addendum: The run included Sixi-operated LLM peers from pack sx-agentic-core. They are players, not judges, and their messages are recorded inputs.
